gloss: bad omen; ill omen; unlucky sign

definitions.gloss: bad omen; ill omen; unlucky sign
definitions.explanation: A sign or event believed to foretell misfortune or disaster. Used both literally in contexts involving superstition and figuratively to describe worrying signs.

examples.japanese: ⟦カラス→カラス：09930_karasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}く→鳴く：04388_naku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{凶兆|きょうちょう}だ⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧。
examples.english: They say a crow cawing is a bad omen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不吉|ふきつ}→不吉：16952_fukitsu⟧な⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{凶兆|きょうちょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{受|う}け{止|と}めた→受け止める：05756_uketomeru⟧。
examples.english: I took the ominous dream as a bad omen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{急落|きゅうらく}→急落：09399_kyuuraku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{凶兆|きょうちょう}⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧。
examples.english: The sharp drop in stock prices may be an omen of an economic crisis.

notes:
A somewhat literary or dramatic word for a bad omen. Appears in novels, news commentary, and discussions of superstitions. The opposite is ⟦{吉兆|きっちょう}→吉兆：17163_kicchou⟧ (good omen).

FORMS:
⟦{凶|きょう}→凶：19345_kyou⟧ (bad luck, misfortune) + ⟦{兆|ちょう}→兆：17936_chou⟧ (sign, omen)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {凶兆|きょうちょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見|み}なす→見なす：10615_minasu⟧: to regard as a bad omen
- {凶兆|きょうちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to sense a bad omen
- {凶兆|きょうちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れる→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧: a bad omen appears

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不吉|ふきつ}→不吉：16952_fukitsu⟧: unlucky, ominous — an adjective describing the quality, while {凶兆|きょうちょう} is the sign itself
- ⟦{吉兆|きっちょう}→吉兆：17163_kicchou⟧: good omen — the direct antonym
- ⟦{前兆|ぜんちょう}→前兆：09118_zenchou⟧: omen, harbinger — neutral (can be good or bad)
- ⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦{予感|よかん}→予感：11416_yokan⟧: bad premonition — more colloquial and personal
